question: Which planned events next quarter are forecast to lose money?
Which tactic gives the best ROI at ValuMax Stores?
How much trade spend did we invest by retailer in the last 52 weeks, and what did it return?
Which promotions lost money in the last 52 weeks?
How big were the pantry-loading dip and cannibalization after ValuMax BOGO events?
What is ROI by retailer and tactic over the last 52 weeks?
What does the ValuMax joint business plan require per quarter, and can BOGO events be switched to scan-based Feature + Display?

description: Post-event analysis, one row per COMPLETED promotion (last 104 weeks): retailer, SKU, tactic, depth, funding method, ML baseline vs actual units, gross incremental, pantry-loading dip, cannibalized sister units, forward-buy units, trade spend, incremental gross profit, net profit, ROI, verdict.

Week-by-week curve per completed promotion (rel_week < 0 before, 0..weeks-1 during, then 4 post weeks): actual vs ML baseline units for the promoted SKU and its sister SKUs, shipments and units bought on deal.

NEXT QUARTER draft promo calendar (13 weeks), one row per planned event with the as-planned forecast: trade spend, net profit, ROI, forecast_flag (Money-losing / Below target / On track) and the recommended compliant alternative.
Re-plan scenarios for every planned event x candidate tactic: forecast units, trade spend, net profit, ROI, TPG-2027 policy check, recommended flag, deltas vs as planned.
Historical response by retailer x tactic x funding method: events, lift multiplier, pantry-loading dip ratio, cannibalization ratio, forward-buy ratio, trade spend, net profit, ROI.
Retailer POS sell-out by week x SKU: units, dollars, average shelf price, promo flag, event id.
The 10 Crestwood salty-snack SKUs: brand, brand family (cannibalization group), shelf price, list price, COGS, unit margin.
Completed trade promotions from the TPM system: tactic, depth, feature/display, funding method, allowance per unit, fixed fees.
Crestwood sell-in (shipments) to each retailer by week x SKU, with units bought on deal (off-invoice allowances).
The 5 retail accounts: channel, stores, default funding method, JBP minimum events per quarter, feature and display fees.

UC metric view of governed trade-promotion KPIs over gold_event_roi: Trade Spend, Net Profit, ROI, Volume Lift, Pantry Loading Share, Cannibalization Share, Money Losing Events by Retailer, Tactic, Funding Method, Brand, Quarter.

content:
Crestwood Snacks Co. (fictional) is a salty-snacks CPG (brands Crestwood Kettle, Crestwood Classic, Ridgeline Tortilla, Twistwell Pretzels, Crestwood Variety) selling through 5 retail accounts: ValuMax Stores (Mass, off-invoice funding), Greenleaf Market and Harbor Fresh Grocers (Grocery, scan-based), QuickPantry (Convenience) and BulkWise Club (Club, off-invoice). Tactics: BOGO (50% effective), Feature + Display (~22% TPR + circular + endcap), TPR (~18% shelf discount), Multi-buy (~30%, 2 for $X).
POST-EVENT ROI (Crestwood TPG-2027 definitions): ROI = SUM(net_profit_usd) / SUM(trade_spend_usd) — always aggregate as a ratio of sums, never average the per-event roi column. net_profit = incremental gross profit - trade spend; a negative ROI / net profit means the event LOST money. Volume lift = SUM(gross_incremental_units) / SUM(baseline_units). The baseline comes from the ML model baseline_demand_model@champion. Show ROI and lifts as percentages with 1 decimal.
LEAKAGE: pantry loading = post_event_dip_units (the dip in the 4 weeks after the event), share of lift = SUM(post_event_dip_units)/SUM(gross_incremental_units). Cannibalization = cannibalized_units (sister SKUs of the same brand family at the same retailer during the event), share = SUM(cannibalized_units)/SUM(gross_incremental_units). Forward buying = forward_buy_units (units the retailer bought on deal beyond what shoppers bought; only off-invoice funding). subsidised_baseline_usd = allowance paid on units that would have sold anyway.
TIME: gold_event_roi covers the last 104 weeks; 'last year' / 'last 52 weeks' = is_last_52_weeks = true. 'Next quarter' / 'the plan' / 'planned events' = gold_plan_forecast (never gold_event_roi). Money-losing planned events: forecast_flag = 'Money-losing' (net_profit_usd < 0).
Retailer names: use retailer_name (e.g. 'ValuMax Stores'); users may say ValuMax. Products: product_name or sku. Always include trade spend and net profit in dollars (rounded to whole dollars) next to ROI.
ROUTING: numbers, counts, amounts, rates, trends -> query the TABLES (SQL); never answer numbers from a document. Policy, procedure, guideline, contract and 'what does the document say' questions -> search the attached documents and cite the document name + section.

question: Show the weekly sales curve of the last ValuMax BOGO event versus its baseline
sql: SELECT w.rel_week, w.phase, w.week_start, w.actual_units, w.baseline_units, w.sister_actual_units, w.sister_baseline_units FROM retail_consumer_goods.trade_promotion_roi.gold_event_weekly w JOIN (SELECT event_id FROM retail_consumer_goods.trade_promotion_roi.gold_event_roi WHERE retailer_name = 'ValuMax Stores' AND tactic = 'BOGO' ORDER BY start_week DESC LIMIT 1) e ON w.event_id = e.event_id ORDER BY w.rel_week

question: How much trade spend did we invest by retailer in the last 52 weeks, and what did it return?
sql: SELECT retailer_name, COUNT(*) AS events, ROUND(SUM(trade_spend_usd), 0) AS trade_spend_usd, ROUND(SUM(incremental_gross_profit_usd), 0) AS incremental_gross_profit_usd, ROUND(SUM(net_profit_usd), 0) AS net_profit_usd, ROUND(100 * SUM(net_profit_usd) / SUM(trade_spend_usd), 1) AS roi_pct FROM retail_consumer_goods.trade_promotion_roi.gold_event_roi WHERE is_last_52_weeks GROUP BY retailer_name ORDER BY trade_spend_usd DESC

question: Which promotions lost money in the last 52 weeks?
sql: SELECT retailer_name, tactic, COUNT(*) AS events_lost_money, ROUND(SUM(trade_spend_usd), 0) AS trade_spend_usd, ROUND(SUM(net_profit_usd), 0) AS net_profit_usd, ROUND(100 * SUM(net_profit_usd) / SUM(trade_spend_usd), 1) AS roi_pct FROM retail_consumer_goods.trade_promotion_roi.gold_event_roi WHERE is_last_52_weeks AND net_profit_usd < 0 GROUP BY retailer_name, tactic ORDER BY net_profit_usd ASC

question: Which planned events next quarter are forecast to lose money?
sql: SELECT plan_event_id, retailer_name, product_name, tactic, start_week, ROUND(trade_spend_usd, 0) AS trade_spend_usd, ROUND(net_profit_usd, 0) AS forecast_net_profit_usd, ROUND(100 * roi, 1) AS forecast_roi_pct, recommended_scenario_label, ROUND(recommended_net_profit_usd, 0) AS recommended_net_profit_usd FROM retail_consumer_goods.trade_promotion_roi.gold_plan_forecast WHERE forecast_flag = 'Money-losing' ORDER BY start_week

question: How big were the pantry-loading dip and cannibalization after ValuMax BOGO events?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS events, ROUND(100 * SUM(gross_incremental_units) / SUM(baseline_units), 1) AS volume_lift_pct, SUM(gross_incremental_units) AS gross_incremental_units, SUM(post_event_dip_units) AS pantry_loading_dip_units, ROUND(100 * SUM(post_event_dip_units) / SUM(gross_incremental_units), 1) AS pantry_loading_pct_of_lift, SUM(cannibalized_units) AS cannibalized_units, ROUND(100 * SUM(cannibalized_units) / SUM(gross_incremental_units), 1) AS cannibalization_pct_of_lift, SUM(forward_buy_units) AS forward_buy_units, ROUND(SUM(trade_spend_usd), 0) AS trade_spend_usd, ROUND(SUM(net_profit_usd), 0) AS net_profit_usd, ROUND(100 * SUM(net_profit_usd) / SUM(trade_spend_usd), 1) AS roi_pct FROM retail_consumer_goods.trade_promotion_roi.gold_event_roi WHERE retailer_name = 'ValuMax Stores' AND tactic = 'BOGO'

question: Which tactic gives the best ROI at ValuMax Stores?
sql: SELECT tactic, funding_method, SUM(events) AS events, ROUND(SUM(trade_spend_usd), 0) AS trade_spend_usd, ROUND(SUM(net_profit_usd), 0) AS net_profit_usd, ROUND(100 * SUM(net_profit_usd) / SUM(trade_spend_usd), 1) AS roi_pct FROM retail_consumer_goods.trade_promotion_roi.gold_tactic_response WHERE retailer_name = 'ValuMax Stores' GROUP BY tactic, funding_method ORDER BY roi_pct DESC

question: What is ROI by retailer and tactic over the last 52 weeks?
sql: SELECT retailer_name, tactic, COUNT(*) AS events, ROUND(SUM(trade_spend_usd), 0) AS trade_spend_usd, ROUND(SUM(net_profit_usd), 0) AS net_profit_usd, ROUND(100 * SUM(net_profit_usd) / SUM(trade_spend_usd), 1) AS roi_pct, ROUND(100 * SUM(gross_incremental_units) / SUM(baseline_units), 1) AS volume_lift_pct FROM retail_consumer_goods.trade_promotion_roi.gold_event_roi WHERE is_last_52_weeks GROUP BY retailer_name, tactic ORDER BY retailer_name, roi_pct DESC
